comments.body:
I was able to reproduce this and it appears to be config-related, not a core server bug.

Repro:
1) Start Temporal with updates disabled:
   temporal server start-dev --dynamic-config-value frontend.enableUpdateWorkflowExecution=false
2) Call Workflow Update from client (executeUpdate/startUpdate)
3) Result: 7 PERMISSION_DENIED: UpdateWorkflowExecution operation is disabled on this namespace.

Verification:
- Restart with updates enabled:
  temporal server start-dev --dynamic-config-value frontend.enableUpdateWorkflowExecution=true
- Same update call succeeds.

Conclusion:
This error is expected when UpdateWorkflowExecution is disabled (globally or for the namespace). 
Recommend checking dynamic config / namespace-level constraints and testing against the intended namespace (not just default).

Let me know if I was able to help you out or not. We can connect further to discuss, and work on this issue.

Agreed, the server has the config [enabled by default ](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/blob/f2a389fbab69f89edfb596d4963c04664db4cf89/common/dynamicconfig/constants.go#L990) and the cli doesn't override it. 
I am going to assume this is a setup misconfig, but if you have more data please let us know
